links.outcome: LLM accuracy on hard pathology questions with vs without retrieval-augmented grounding
links.effect: YpathRAG increased accuracies of both general and medical LLMs by 9.0% on average and up to 15.6% on the 300 hardest YpathQA-M questions.
links.quote: on YpathQA-M, a set of the 300 most challenging questions, it increases the accuracies of both general and medical LLMs by 9.0% on average and up to 15.6%.

unlisted_practices: Dual-channel hybrid retrieval (dense plus vocabulary-guided sparse) for domain RAG
LLM-based supportive-evidence judgment module between retrieval and generation
Building a large domain-specific pathology vector database

screen.reason: Evaluates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with supportive-evidence judgment as an external grounding/safeguard strategy to improve factual reliability and accuracy on multiple general and medical LLMs.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding added to existing LLMs
